items.question: What is Accomp?
items.answer: Accomp is a mobile app concept with one core feature: shared trip planning. It brings planning, gear preparation, and offline-ready trip information into one shared trip space.

items.question: Can everyone help plan the same trip?
items.answer: The planned experience lets invited companions view and contribute to shared trip details. Exact collaboration controls will be confirmed before launch.

items.question: Can I use Accomp without a signal?
items.answer: Accomp is being designed around offline readiness, including prepared maps and essential trip information. Final offline capabilities will be announced before launch.

items.question: Who is Accomp for?
items.answer: Accomp is designed for hiking groups, backpackers, campers, weekend adventurers, and friends who want one clear plan before heading outdoors.

items.question: Will Accomp be available on iOS and Android?
items.answer: Platform availability has not been confirmed yet. This site will be updated when the release plan is ready.

items.question: When will Accomp launch?
items.answer: A launch date has not been announced. The waitlist shown here remains a design preview until a consented signup system is available.

items.question: Is Accomp free?
items.answer: Pricing has not been announced. Confirmed product and launch details will appear here before release.

privacy.metaDescription: Current privacy and data-handling status for the Accomp marketing website.
privacy.title: Privacy at Accomp.
privacy.lede: This page records how the pre-launch marketing website currently handles information.
privacy.noticeBody: This is an operational privacy notice for the current preview, not the final policy for the Accomp mobile app.

sections.title: Information collection
sections.body: The current website does not accept waitlist submissions, create accounts, process purchases, or ask visitors to provide personal information.

sections.title: Analytics and cookies
sections.body: Accomp has not enabled analytics, advertising trackers, or application cookies on this website. Because there are no optional cookies, no consent banner is shown.

sections.title: Future changes
sections.body: Before any form, analytics service, or optional cookie is activated, this notice will be replaced with an approved privacy policy and an appropriate consent experience.

sections.title: Contact readiness
sections.body: A verified legal entity and public privacy contact have not been supplied yet. Both remain release requirements before personal information can be collected.

terms.title: A clear pre-launch status.
terms.lede: These terms explain the limited role of the current Accomp marketing preview.
terms.noticeBody: The Accomp app has not launched, so this page does not create an app account, subscription, purchase, or service relationship.

sections.title: Website purpose
sections.body: This website introduces the Accomp mobile app concept and its intended direction. It is informational and does not currently provide the app itself.

sections.title: Illustrative content
sections.body: App interfaces, trip information, readiness states, maps, and dates shown on the site are illustrative. Product capabilities, platforms, pricing, and launch timing remain subject to confirmation.

sections.title: No submissions or transactions
sections.body: The waitlist control is disabled. The website does not accept personal information, payments, bookings, or user-generated content.

sections.title: Release requirement
sections.body: Final terms, a verified legal entity, and a public contact must be approved before Accomp offers a live service or accepts a registration.
